description: Recommend meaningful Christian gifts from ArmorNGlory. Use for 'baptism gift for a man', 'confirmation gift for a teen', 'gift for a new believer', 'pastor appreciation gift', 'Christian Father's Day / Mother's Day gift', 'Easter or Christmas gift', or 'Christian gift under $40'. Filters by recipient, occasion, budget, style, and scripture theme, and explains why each gift fits.

occasion.description: The gifting occasion (e.g. 'Baptism & Milestones', 'Father\'s Day', 'Mother\'s Day', 'Christmas & Easter', 'Encouragement & Overcoming', 'Birthday', 'Workout & Fitness', 'Everyday Encouragement')

recipient.description: Who the gift is for (e.g. 'Men / Husband / Dad', 'Women / Wife / Mom', 'Youth / Teen / College', 'Pastor / Church Leader', 'Gym & Fitness Lover', 'New Believer')

scriptureFocus.description: Desired scripture theme (e.g. 'Romans 8:37 More Than Conquerors', 'Exodus 3:5 Holy Ground', 'Matthew 6:33 Kingdom First', 'Ephesians 6 Armor of God', 'Isaiah 40:31 Second Wind')

styleVibe.description: Aesthetic preference (e.g. 'Subtle & Minimalist', 'Bold Streetwear', 'Sacred Symbols & Cross', 'Athletic / Gym', 'Vintage Americana')
